insights.one_liner: Radboud University is a Dutch research university in Nijmegen and an IND recognised sponsor; it has been in the news over a research fraud case.

culture.text: A Dutch research university in Nijmegen.
Launched a campaign about neurodiversity in the workplace.

open.text: Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open research job here does not require Dutch and shows the pay.

growth.text: Provisional enrolment figures show slight growth at Radboud, in line with other universities.

worth_knowing.text: A former associate professor is accused of large-scale research fraud, called one of the biggest integrity cases in the Netherlands.
Banned a far-right student association from its introduction market after it was named in an AIVD/NCTV report.
Some staff are angry that the university funds an institute in Russia.
